Require a diagnosed refusal and a corrective action before each publication redispatch, keeping a budget-only healthy-tree refusal out of the automatic worker retry path. This removes repetitions that cannot repair a tree while retaining the existing after-landing cycle-time report and budget threshold.

```diff
+Budget-only healthy-tree refusals preserve work and surface the measured gate and host conditions.

```
